decisions.statement: The saved table is read as `TemperCharacters_SavedVariables` or as `Temper_SavedVariables`.
Which companion a definition id names is asked of the caller.
A companion the caller cannot name is counted as skipped.
A character that will not read is counted as skipped.
A lua key written as a number is kept as text.
Diagnostics come back alongside the records rather than reaching a log.

definition: the addon's saved variables file turned into records of what is complete
